name: azure-resource-manager-cosmosdb-dotnet
summary: 微软的指南介绍如何在 .NET 中通过 Azure Resource Manager 预配 Cosmos DB 账户、数据库和容器，并配置吞吐量。先添加 Azure.ResourceManager.CosmosDB 和 Azure.Identity 包。指南仅涵盖管理平面操作，读写文档需使用 Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos。

Microsoft’s guide shows how to provision Cosmos DB accounts, databases, and containers and configure throughput through Azure Resource Manager in .NET. Start by adding the Azure.ResourceManager.CosmosDB and Azure.Identity packages. The guide covers management-plane operations only. Reading and writing documents requires Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos.
